I believe this company is Best Buy. What gave it away for me was the retail, electronics bib box and several other statements around CEO (Best Buy was a former client of mine). 

Major exec changes may reflect chaos, instability, etc. I believe this is important for solverah users to have a view of this and wondering if this is a dimension or not?
